title: CKAD Practice - Multi-Container Pods (10% of exam)

questions.title: Create a Pod with two containers, both with image...
questions.body: Create a Pod with two containers, both with image busybox and command "echo hello; sleep 3600". Connect to the second container and run 'ls'

questions.title: Create a pod with an nginx container exposed on port 80....
questions.body: Create a pod with an nginx container exposed on port 80. Add a busybox init container which downloads a page using 'echo "Test" > /work-dir/index.html'. Make a volume of type emptyDir and mount it in both containers. For the nginx container, mount it on "/usr/share/nginx/html" and for the initcontainer, mount it on "/work-dir". When done, get the IP of the created pod and create a busybox pod and run "wget -O- IP"
